title: Juicy Peppery Lime Leaves Stir-fry
description: This adventurous Syrian dish features lime leaves that are caramelized and combined with a juicy mix of vegetables for a low-sodium-friendly meal.

ingredients.name: 3 lime leaves (fresh)
ingredients.notes: Trim the stems and remove any tough parts.

ingredients.name: 1 small red bell pepper, cut into strips
2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce (or tamari for gluten-free option)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the lime leaves and sauté until they start to wilt slightly.
Add the onion, bell pepper, garlic, and broccoli florets to the pan. Stir-fry for about 5 minutes until vegetables are tender but still crisp.
Pour in the squeezed lime juice and add the low-sodium soy sauce. Mix well to combine all ingredients.
Adjust seasoning with salt if needed (since it’s a low-sodium dish, adjust sparingly).
Serve hot as a side or main course.
